title: HistoryOutcome
description: How keeping the version a write replaced, in the local history, ended (plan 07, F8). In the domain this is a discriminated union — `{ kept: true, entryId }` or `{ kept: false, reason }` — which the generator cannot express as a `oneOf`; flattened here into one shape with `entryId` present only when `kept` is `true` and `reason` only when it is `false` (plan 28, B-48).

kept.description: Whether the replaced version was kept in the local history.

entryId.description: The entry the version was kept under. Present exactly when `kept` is `true`.

reason.description: Why it was not kept. Present exactly when `kept` is `false`.
